# SYNESIS_E078 — Error

## Description

`MODIFIER` in `field_name` (SCOPE ITEM) — only valid in SCOPE SOURCE.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
The field `field_name` uses `MODIFIER`, but it is declared with
  `SCOPE ITEM`. The linkage modifiers (`IDENTIFIES` / `REFERS TO`)
  only make sense in `SCOPE SOURCE` fields — linkage between projects
  works on SOURCEs (collection units), not on ITEMs or concepts.
  Move the modifier to a SOURCE field, or remove it from this field.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **LinkageModifierOutsideSource**: `field_name`, `modifier`, `scope`
